fusions.name: Ram and Rip
fusions.desc: Butts the target and stabs it, dealing 12 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: From the High Ledge
fusions.desc: Throws a knife up to 9 tiles that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.5 times harder at maximum range.

fusions.name: Won't Be Moved
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Cornered Billy
fusions.desc: When your health falls low, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
